details.failure_summary: Timeout waiting for Information section 'Show' link to appear (10000ms exceeded, all 3 retries failed)
details.reasoning: The test failed all 3 retry attempts with the same error: 'Locator.wait_for: Timeout 10000ms exceeded' when trying to click the Information section's 'Show' link. This is a consistent, reproducible failure (not flaky — every retry fails identically), indicating the UI element is genuinely missing or the Information section feature is broken/changed in the current build. This warrants investigation as a real product regression.
